_selection_status_note: These architecture and optimiser settings were prespecified rather than tuned, then evaluated in the completed matched experiment recorded under results/09_nonlinear_mlp_heads and results/10_synthetic_augmentation.
_device_note: CUDA is the research default. If CUDA is requested and unavailable, fitting refuses with status blocked_missing_cuda_or_resources. CPU only on an explicit --device cpu / device='cpu' (portability, unit and smoke tests).
_min_category_count_note: Same threshold as component 05's corrected train-only protocol (foundation_model_corrections_config.json).
_embedding_note: Prognostic uses the documented 'combined' block (512 event + 512 time dimensions = 1,024), as in component 05. The saved embeddings were computed once across the full cohort, so embedding-mode results are not automatically a strict head-to-head with clinical-variable mode.

inner_validation.prognostic_stratify: os_event x tertile of os_months (tertile cut points from the outer-training rows); falls back to os_event alone, then to unstratified, when a stratum has fewer than min_stratum_size rows

diagnostic._class_weighting_note: 'balanced' sets pos_weight = n_negative / n_positive computed from the fit rows only.

prognostic._batch_size_note: null = full batch, so every Cox risk set is the complete set of fit rows at risk. A finite batch size computes the partial likelihood within each batch (a documented approximation).
